    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the header and date for the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B'S"D.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbat Parshat Va'eira,</t>
    <t s="2">Rosh Chodesh Shevat,</t>

  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses the distinction between the revelation of the name Havayah to the Patriarchs and its revelation at the Giving of the Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"And Elokim spoke to Moshe and said to him, 'I am Havayah. And I appeared to Avraham, to Yitzchak, and to Yaakov... but My name Havayah I did not make known to them.'"</t>
    <t s="1">And the precise point</t>
    <t s="2">in this of the Baal HaHilula is known, regarding what is said, "but My name Havayah I did not make known to them,"</t>
    <t s="3">for is not the name Havayah stated many times in speech to the Patriarchs?</t>
    <t s="4">And as Rashi's commentary raised this difficulty.</t>
    <t s="5">Also, one must understand what is said here specifically, "I am Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="6">what is the connection of the name Havayah to the Exodus from Egypt and to the Giving of the Torah</t>
    <t s="7">(which are connected to each other,</t>
    <t s="8">as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="9">"When you take the people out of Egypt, you will serve Elokim on this mountain").</t>
    <t s="10">Now, from what is explained in this discourse in Torah Or,</t>
    <t s="11">it is understood</t>
    <t s="12">that to the Patriarchs, the name Havayah was revealed only through the name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="13">which in general is the aspect of the name Havayah below,</t>
    <t s="14">but the name Havayah above was not made known to them,</t>
    <t s="15">unlike at the Giving of the Torah, when the name Havayah that is above enclothing in the name Elokim was revealed,</t>
    <t s="16">the aspect of the name Havayah above.</t>
    <t s="17">Therefore, before the Giving of the Torah, there was a decree</t>
    <t s="18">that the upper ones would not descend to the lower ones and the lower ones would not ascend to the upper ones,</t>
    <t s="19">and at the Giving of the Torah, the Holy One, blessed be He, nullified the decree and said that the lower ones will ascend to the upper ones,</t>
    <t s="20">and the upper ones will descend to the lower ones,</t>
    <t s="21">and I will begin,</t>
    <t s="22">as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="23">"And Havayah descended upon Mount Sinai,"</t>
    <t s="24">and it is written,</t>
    <t s="25">"And to Moshe He said, 'Ascend to Havayah.'"</t>
    <t s="26">And this is what is said to him here, "I am Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="27">that a new revelation begins,</t>
    <t s="28">that the name Havayah which is above enclothing in the name Elokim will be revealed,</t>
    <t s="29">the name Havayah above.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
